entities.criteria:
<GROUND_RULES>
Use ONLY explicit document text provided with this prompt. No assumptions. Scan all text.

Output EXACTLY 3 lines (commas only):
EMPLOYEE: <hrs>, <WP>, <eff>, <AAW>
DEPENDENTS: Spouse <key>, Child <key>
REHIRE: <window>, <impact>

LIMITS: MAX 16 words/line. Use: hrs/wk, hrs/mo, WP, eff, AAW, DOH, 1st of mo, d.
NULLS: no bare Null. Use: hrs Null, WP Null, eff Null, AAW Null, Spouse Null, Child Null, window Null, impact Null.

ANCHORS (must search for these):
EMPLOYEE: "Minimum Hours" OR "hours per week" OR "Waiting Period" OR "When Insurance Begins" OR "first day of the month"
AAW: "Actively Working" OR "Active Work" OR "return to Active Work"
SPOUSE: "Spouse means" OR "domestic partner" OR "civil union"
CHILD: "Dependent Child means" OR "stepchild" OR "foster" OR "adopted" OR "child of your spouse/domestic partner/civil union"
REHIRE: "Reinstatement" OR "rehire" OR "reinstated" OR "within 90 days" OR "without satisfying another Waiting Period"

PICK RULES:
EMPLOYEE: hrs=min hrs (prefer hrs/wk; add hrs/mo only if stated). WP=shortest WP (class split only if explicit). eff=shortest trigger (prefer 1st of mo/DOH). AAW="AAW req" if any Actively Working/return-to-Active-Work gating; else "AAW Null".
DEPENDENTS: use ONLY definitions: "Spouse means" and "Dependent Child means". Spouse key="lawful spouse" + add "/DP/civil union" if explicit. Child key=relationship list (bio/adopt/step/foster + add DP/civil union if explicit); else Child Null.
REHIRE: window=day-based reinstatement/rehire window (prefer general). impact="no new WP" if no additional/another waiting period; else "prior svc counts" if stated; else impact Null.
</GROUND_RULES>

<QUESTIONS>
Produce the 3-line output.
</QUESTIONS>

<EXAMPLES>
EMPLOYEE: 35 hrs/wk, WP 30 d, eff 1st of mo, AAW req
DEPENDENTS: Spouse lawful spouse/DP/civil union, Child bio/step/adopt/foster/DP/civil union
REHIRE: 90 d, no new WP
</EXAMPLES>

<GROUND_RULES>
Use ONLY the explicit context provided. No assumptions or external policy knowledge.
If termination timing cannot be determined explicitly, output Null.

Output EXACTLY one line:
Coverage terminates <timing>
OR
Null

Where <timing> is the shortest explicit timing phrase tied to employee coverage ending
(e.g., date of employment termination, end of month of employment termination, last day worked).

Selection:
- If an employment-termination timing phrase exists (employment termination/last day worked/cessation of employment), use it.
- Otherwise, use the most direct employee coverage-end timing stated (avoid continuation/exception mechanics).
Telegram fragments only. No extra triggers list. No fluff.
</GROUND_RULES>

<QUESTION>
Return the termination timing in the required format. <timing/Null>
</QUESTION>

<OUTPUT_FORMAT>
Coverage terminates <timing>
</OUTPUT_FORMAT>

<EXAMPLES>
Coverage terminates date of employment termination
Coverage terminates end of month of employment termination
Coverage terminates last day worked
Null
</EXAMPLES>

<GROUND_RULES>
Use ONLY explicit context. No assumptions.
Classify PARTIAL/RESIDUAL benefit approach (ignore general offsets).
If partial/residual not described, output Null.

Output EXACTLY ONE:
Progressive partial disability
Proportionate loss
50% offset
Other partial formula
Definition only (no formula)
Null

Pick FIRST match:
1) Progressive partial disability = work incentive / excess-only cap: “incentive to work”, “benefit+earnings exceeds X%”, “reduced by excess”, “not reduced first X months”, “total benefit unless…”.
2) Proportionate loss = proportional/ratio formula: “proportionate/proportional”, “% of earnings lost”, “loss ÷ pre-disability”, “benefit × ratio”.
3) 50% offset = reduced by 50% (½) of earnings: “50% of earnings”, “50 cents per $1”, “offset by 1/2”.
4) Other partial formula = any other explicit partial/residual benefit calc.
5) Definition only (no formula) = eligibility only; no partial/residual benefit calc/cap/reduction.

Do NOT use earnings thresholds that only define “Disabled” unless tied to partial/residual benefit calc.
</GROUND_RULES>

<QUESTION>
Classify the approach. <label/Null>
</QUESTION>

<EXAMPLES>
Progressive partial disability
Proportionate loss
50% offset
Other partial formula
Definition only (no formula)
Null
</EXAMPLES>

<GROUND_RULES>
Use ONLY the explicit context provided. No assumptions or external policy knowledge.
If the disability definition cannot be determined, output Null.

Output EXACTLY ONE of these:
- Duties and <loss>% earnings loss
- Duties and earnings loss
- Duties only
- Earnings loss only
- Null

RULES:
1) Duties present only if the definition explicitly requires inability/prevention to perform material duties.
2) Earnings present only if the definition explicitly requires an earnings/income test.

NUMERIC RULE:
- If BOTH duties + earnings are present AND an explicit earnings threshold X% is stated, compute loss = 100 - X and output:
  "Duties and <loss>% earnings loss"
- If BOTH duties + earnings are present BUT no explicit X% threshold is stated, output:
  "Duties and earnings loss"

SINGLE-FACTOR:
- If duties only, output "Duties only".
- If earnings only, output "Earnings loss only".

Do NOT include any other wording, numbers, or clauses.
Ignore own-occ/any-occ transitions and duration language unless needed to detect duties/earnings/threshold.
</GROUND_RULES>

<QUESTION>
Return the label as required. <label/Null>
</QUESTION>

<EXAMPLES>
Duties and 1% earnings loss
Duties and earnings loss
Duties only
Earnings loss only
Null
</EXAMPLES>
